description: When a stored flag bit and a second bit are both set, it clears the flag, writes eight sprite pointers and then calls a routine. Otherwise it sets a stored value to 32.

name: match_string_into_table
description: Copies a null-terminated string into a fixed buffer and zeroes four counters. It scans a table of eight-longword entries for a matching set of four values, looping forever if none match, then stores a field from the match and polls until a counter goes negative.

name: write_cia_port_b_full
description: Writes all ones to the CIA B port data register. It returns straight away.

name: read_cia_port_then_handshake
description: Reads a CIA port value on entry, waits for a status bit to clear, then either writes zero and a handshake pattern to the CIA B port or writes a fixed pattern. It returns the value read at entry.

name: step_port_toward_target_value
description: Sets or clears control bits on the CIA B port and steps toward a target value, calling a routine repeatedly until it returns zero. A zero input runs a reset sequence and waits on a status bit.

name: pulse_port_bit_and_delay
description: Clears bit 0 of a CIA B port value, sets it again, and runs a fixed countdown delay.

name: reset_counter_and_bit_two
description: Clears a counter and bit 2 of a stored CIA B port value, then sets bit 2 again when bit 0 is clear.

name: start_disk_dma_wait
description: Sets disk controller and DMA values, waits for two status bits, starts a transfer, and calls a routine to check the outcome. It returns its stack argument unchanged.

name: update_cia_bit_two_call
description: Clears a stored port value, which leaves bit 0 unset so bit 2 is set, and then calls a routine.

name: retry_disk_read_five
description: Runs a disk read sequence while counting attempts up to five. It returns all ones if a checked value matches a stored count, and zero when the attempts are used up.

name: continue_disk_read_attempts
description: Continues the disk read attempt loop from a point partway through. It returns all ones if a checked value matches a stored count, and zero when the attempts are used up.

name: check_and_retry_disk_read
description: Calls two routines, then returns all ones if a checked value matches a stored count. Otherwise it repeats the disk read attempts, returning zero once they are used up.

name: repeat_call_word_countdown
description: Calls one routine repeatedly in a countdown loop over a word counter until the counter passes below zero.

name: call_pair_and_return
description: Calls two routines in order and returns. It does no work of its own.

name: write_merged_bitplane_longword
description: Builds a longword from the alternating bits of a register value, adjusting one bit from the preceding byte's low bit, and stores it at the destination.

name: merge_longword_pairs_into_buffer
description: Walks pairs of longwords and merges the alternating bits of each pair into one output longword. It runs a counted number of times and stores the results in a destination buffer.

name: merge_last_longword_pair
description: Walks a counted number of longword pairs and returns the merged value of the final pair.

name: set_bit_in_table_word
description: Sets one bit, chosen by a register value, in a word of a table selected by an index.

name: load_block_when_idle
description: When a stored value is zero, calls four routines and then copies 1408 longwords from a table into a global block.

name: copy_block_update_port
description: Calls two routines, copies 1408 longwords from a global block into a table, then updates bit 2 of a stored port value from bit 0.

name: copy_sector_default_length
description: Calls two routines when a check value differs from a global, then copies one sector's bytes into the destination. The length comes from a header word when that word is negative, otherwise a default of 508 bytes is used.

name: fill_track_gap_pattern
description: Fills a buffer with alternating-bit fill words, then writes a sync word and fill longwords before a long run of the same fill word.

key: Ultima V - Warriors of Destiny (1990)(Mindscape)[cr Angels - Genesis - Defjam](Disk 1 of 2)(Play).adf +$0 run at $004000 (352 bytes, matched to executed PCs):0:0100
name: load_and_decompress_boot_data
description: Sets up an I/O request, reads data through the Exec library's DoIO call, and copies it into memory. It decodes a compressed stream of literal bytes, back-references and run markers, then walks a text string line by line.

name: reset_six_global_words
description: Calls one routine, then writes one fixed word value and five zero words into consecutive global words. The hardware register names in its facts are not written directly by this code.

name: release_resources_at_entry
description: Program entry point. It calls two routines, makes a counted series of library-vector calls, and clears a stored pointer before returning. The facts record a call to the Exec library's FreeMem function.

name: decrement_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a local word counter until it passes below zero, then returns.

name: unpack_stream_via_vector
description: Reads a stream through a routine vector and unpacks it, with flag bits choosing between literal and copy paths. Copies repeat longword values from earlier positions in the output.

name: unpack_bitstream_back_references
description: Continues the bit-stream unpacker, reading length and distance codes from the input bits and copying runs of earlier output. It writes decoded bytes backward into the output buffer.

name: unpack_bitstream_byte_runs
description: Decodes length and distance codes from the input bit stream and copies runs of earlier bytes into the output buffer. It loops until its counters are used up.

name: load_amiga_executable_hunks
description: Loads an AmigaDOS executable by reading its hunk records. It allocates memory for code and data hunks, applies relocation entries, and stops at the end marker. The facts record Exec library memory allocation and release calls.

name: decrement_word_until_wrap
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter until it wraps past zero, then returns.

name: copy_run_backward_with_fill
description: Copies bytes into a buffer from its end toward its start, using counts read through a routine and fill runs taken from the source. It returns once the output pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

name: shift_bit_buffer_by_count
description: Shifts a bit buffer by a count held in a register, refilling it from the input when it empties. It repeats this for a counted number of steps.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Issues system trap six, then runs into data that does not decode as valid instructions, so the code after it cannot be recovered.

name: initialise_border_state
description: Clears eight longwords of state and stores a value returned by a call. It calls a library vector when a flag bit is set, then calls another library vector function or a routine, depending on the result.

name: report_intuition_library_routine
description: Refers to a version string and the intuition.library name, and makes seven routine calls. The decompiler produced no pseudo-code, so its behaviour beyond those calls is not recovered.

name: call_present_resource_routines
description: Calls routines only for resources that are present, checking a stored pointer and a status byte first. It calls one routine with a computed argument, calls another with a stored value when it is set, and then calls a final routine.

name: setup_console_device_request
description: Calls library vector functions and routines in sequence, referencing the console device text. It checks a type field and a stored pointer, and when both match it allocates a request block, links it into a list, and returns a value from that block.

name: configure_border_structure_fields
description: Sets pointers and flag bits in a structure using a library vector call and a text reference to Border. It finishes with two routine calls.

name: configure_border_structure_flags
description: Sets up pointers and clears or sets flag bits in a structure, calling a library vector and a routine when a stored field is zero. It finishes with a further routine call.

name: call_border_routines_with_coordinates
description: Computes four offsets from stored structure fields and calls routines with those coordinates. It finishes with one more routine call using the value 10.

name: delay_after_coordinate_calls
description: Calls routines with coordinates computed from stored structure fields, then makes a delay call through the DOS library and calls a library vector function.

name: store_parameter_and_call_routine
description: Stores its first parameter in a stored field, then calls a routine with the second parameter and a stack address.

name: call_dos_library_open_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns. It references the dos.library name, and the facts record Exec library calls for opening a library, raising an alert and supervisor-mode access.

name: return_empty_routine
description: Contains nothing but a return, so it changes no memory or registers.

name: set_up_dos_stream_block
description: Allocates a block of six-byte entries and fills its flags, then uses DOS calls for current directory, input, output and file open. It writes a four-letter marker into the block and releases the block if the allocation fails.

name: split_command_line_words
description: Splits a command line into words, honouring double-quoted sections and doubled quotes. It stores a null-terminated copy of each word, allocates a pointer array for them, and fills it, ending with a null pointer.

name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination, stopping at the terminator or after a count, then fills any remaining count with zero bytes.

name: append_string_capped
description: Finds the end of the destination string and appends the source string, copying at most 32766 bytes and terminating the result.

name: append_string_with_count
description: Finds the end of the destination string and copies the source onto it, stopping at the terminator or when a count runs out. If the count expires first, it writes a null terminator after the copied bytes.

name: compare_two_byte_strings
description: Compares two byte strings up to a limit of 32766 characters. It returns minus one when the first differing byte is smaller in the first string, one when it is larger, and zero when the strings match to the terminator or the limit.

name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies a null-terminated source string into a destination, including the terminator, and returns the destination pointer.

name: lookup_icon_library_objects
description: References the WINDOW text and icon.library, opens a file through the DOS library, and calls several library vector functions. It links a found object's fields into a structure when the lookups succeed, and releases the opened handle at the end.

name: call_and_terminate_buffer
description: Stores its first parameter as a pointer, calls a routine with the second parameter and a stack address, then writes a zero byte at the stored pointer and returns the call's result.

name: call_terminate_buffer_return_word
description: Stores its first parameter as a pointer, calls a routine, writes a zero byte at that pointer, and returns the call's word result.

name: write_byte_advance_pointer
description: Writes its byte parameter at a stored pointer, advances the pointer by one, and returns the byte.

name: call_with_stack_argument_list
description: Calls a routine with its format argument and the address of its stack argument list, then returns.

name: report_missing_pseudocode
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this routine, so its behaviour cannot be recovered from the evidence. The facts record its instruction count and the routines it calls.

name: format_text_into_output
description: Walks a format string, passing literal characters to a callback and handling conversions for signed and unsigned numbers, characters, strings, and numbers in several bases. Width and precision fields are honoured. It returns the number of characters produced, or minus one when a callback fails.

name: perform_signed_division
description: Works out the sign of the result from two signed inputs, calls a division routine, negates the result when needed, and returns it with the second input in the low longword.

name: call_and_return_concatenated
description: Calls one routine and returns a 64-bit value that combines the original second register with the value the call left in that register.

name: call_single_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns.

name: perform_32bit_division
description: Calculates the quotient and remainder of a 32-bit unsigned division. It uses a bit-shifting method for large divisors and standard division for smaller ones, returning both in one 64-bit value.

name: compute_string_length
description: Walks forward through a zero-terminated byte string and returns its length, excluding the terminator. It does not modify memory.

name: call_single_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns.

name: report_missing_pseudocode
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this routine, so its behaviour cannot be recovered from the evidence. The facts record its instruction count and the routines it calls.

name: return_empty_routine
description: Contains nothing but a return, so it changes no memory or registers.
